record_title: Weighted-histogram certificates for the edge multiset dimension of Q7–Q10
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Originality to the best of our knowledge. No independent-review badge is asserted. The result is dimension-specific for Q7–Q10 and does not claim a general d+2 theorem. Local verifier files mentioned by the source report were unavailable during archival publication.
